group_assessment.counts_note: total_publications and publications_on_gene are 0 because no per-author output count was measured in this pass. A zero here means NOT MEASURED, not zero publications.
group_assessment.note: Research-group knowledge base excluded from the public edition; this rests on measured PubMed counts and the paper's own author and reference lists.
group_assessment.counts_measured: PubMed esearch 2026-10-02 (tool=LEGEND-research): 'WWOX AND TIAF1' 9 records and 'WWOX AND TIAF1 NOT Chang NS[au]' 0 records; '"TRAPPC6A" AND (aggregation OR plaque)' 4 records, all four from this laboratory; 'Zfra' 17 records and 'Zfra NOT Chang NS[au]' 1 record, which is an unrelated zebrafish androgen-receptor paper matching the string by accident; 'WWOX AND "dorsal root ganglion"' 1 record, the group's own.
group_assessment.self_citation_measured: Of this review's 98 references 93 carry a PMID; 40 of those have Chang NS as an author and 41 have Chang NS or Sze CI, and all five PMID-less references are the group's own. That is 46 of 98, 47 percent.
group_assessment.weighting: A narrative review by the originating laboratory. It carries no cohort and no experiment of its own, so nothing may inherit DATO status from it; it is useful here only as the place where the group's claims are stated most compactly and can be traced to their primaries.

verbatim_locators.source_fulltext_indexed_evidence: Europe PMC JATS XML fingerprinted and read end to end, including Table 1 and all three figure legends. The three figure rasters were retrieved from the PMC open-access S3 mirror but are schematic diagrams carrying no data; they were not needed for any locator and are not fingerprinted here. The review has no supplementary material.
verbatim_locators.abstract_anchoring_waived: No locator is abstract-anchored; each entry marks a sentence that is a restatement rather than a measurement.

entries.proposition: THE REVIEW'S CENTRAL MECHANISM SENTENCE - 'WWOX binds Tau via its C-terminal SDR domain' - OCCURS ONLY IN ITS ABSTRACT. Measured over the fingerprinted artefact: that phrase occurs once, inside <abstract>, and zero times in the body; the body never states a direct WWOX-tau binding through the SDR domain at all. What the body states is the GSK-3beta version quoted here, attributed to references 41 and 49, both of which have Chang NS as an author. For an SDR-destabilising allele class this matters: the direct-binding form of the claim is a review abstract's sentence.
entries.snippet: SDR domain binds and blocks GSK-3β-mediated tau hyperphosphorylation and thereby promotes neuronal differentiation
entries.anchor: Section 6.1, 'WWOX-Interacting Partners for AD', third binding mode

entries.proposition: The review's own directional split - pY33-WWOX protective, pS14-WWOX pathogenic - is stated as a conclusion whose mechanism the authors declare unknown in the same paragraph. It is carried here as a restatement, not as a measurement.
entries.snippet: Overall, pY33-WWOX prevents neurodegeneration. In stark contrast, pS14-WWOX enhances the progression of neurodegeneration. The underlying signaling pathways that lead to divergent outcomes remain to be established

entries.proposition: THE DEVELOPMENTAL-TIMING CLAIM IS A CEILING, NOT A LATENCY. Fifteen days is close to the Wwox-null mouse's entire lifespan - the same laboratory reports survival of about a month - so the statement bounds the observation window rather than measuring how fast aggregation occurs. It is also juvenile, not embryonic: the cascade has no embryonic datum at any node.
entries.snippet: it only takes less than 15 days after birth to let the brain proteins polymerize and aggregate in a cascade-like manner
entries.anchor: Section 7.2, 'WWOX Downregulation and Induction of Protein Aggregation Cascade'

entries.proposition: The 'stronger binding is better' principle, which the review carries into a therapeutic recommendation, is stated as a heuristic transferred from cancer suppression. It is a stated analogy, not a measurement in neurons.
entries.snippet: the stronger the binding strength between WWOX and its partner proteins, the better the extent of cancer suppression
entries.anchor: Section 10.3, 'Manipulating the Binding Strength between WWOX and Binding Partner Proteins to Limit Disease Progression'
